name: protect-mcp
description: Security gateway that wraps any MCP server with per-tool policies, approval gates, and optional Ed25519-signed decision receipts. Shadow mode logs every tool call without blocking; enforce mode applies block, rate-limit, and minimum-tier rules. Receipts are independently verifiable offline with no accounts needed.
